title: Value is preserved by restriction
statement: Let $P$ be a raw constraint satisfaction instance over a domain $D$, with a finite family of allowed predicates. For every assignment to all variables, the value of its restriction to the participating variables in the instance with isolated variables removed equals the value of the original assignment in $P$.
hypotheses_covered: An assignment to all variables is given
The allowed predicate family is finite (part of the constraint template)
